scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --local
scripts.dev:fixtures: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc --local --var FIXTURE_MODE:true
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy:check: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm test && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
